scientific_integrity: The finite exhaustion is proved exhaustive by canonical-representative and prefix-recursion arguments, and checked with independent exact LCS implementations.
scientific_limitations: Only a necessary parameter bound and the strict 9/10 finite cutoff are proved; the optimal unbounded ternary epsilon is unresolved. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Sharp length-32 cutoff for ternary 9/10-synchronization strings
